page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.large is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The configuration provides 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Accompanying the processor is 4.0 GB of system memory, establishing an allocated memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU typical for compute-focused configurations.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external block storage for persistent operating system and application data. Network connectivity operates with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. It contains no specialized GPU acceleration hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, ecs.c6t.large is architected for steady workloads that do not demand large in-memory working sets. The resource balance makes it appropriate for microservices, front-end web serving, continuous integration build agents, batch processing tasks, and ingress proxy routing.
